evidence_scope: full 2000-session train_explore shared-cohort diagnostic candidate-recall probe; target-cluster outer folds are diagnostics, not private or independent validation

global_incumbent_context.interpretation: comparable shared-cohort OOF incumbent; not a private score; this probe does not change or evaluate Top10

unique_mechanism.name: EXPOSE_EXISTING_R08_CANDIDATES_101_TO_200
unique_mechanism.capture_boundary: inside a dedicated Agent subclass at _apply_p11 entry, snapshot rankings['final'] after the existing coverage cascade and before P11
unique_mechanism.c200: r08_full[:min(200,len(r08_full))] without padding, backfill, rewrite, rescore, or membership filtering
unique_mechanism.existing_upper_bound: broad BM25 LIMIT 120 plus strict BM25 LIMIT 80 followed by stable union, frozen fusion, and coverage ordering yields at most 200 unique candidates
unchanged: BM25 weights, fusion score, stable tie order, coverage cascade, state parsing, and question order
P11, v1.9, fixed-two-page grace, score-priority, and every Top10 output
catalog, proxy, folds, evaluator semantics, and all model parameters
unique_mechanism.runtime_policy: diagnostic-only and default off; C200 is never served and cannot directly control Top10

train_explore_proxy.access: first existence/stat/open/hash/read only after the durable experiment receipt

label_archive.access: one same-handle open only after both isolated workers close and both candidate traces pass hash, schema, C100 identity, and exact-repeat gates

visible_context_reference.policy: rebuild once after receipt into a new ignored O_EXCL cache, close and verify exact reference identity before either worker starts; worker receives only this identifier-free cache and the catalog

frozen_c100_blind_trace.normalized_c100_record: canonical JSON object {'c100':ordered_pool,'ordinal':global_1_based_ordinal,'turn':one_based_turn} plus one LF

formal_protocol.preflight: may hash target-free catalog, tracked sources, preregistration, frozen C100 blind traces, Git and environment; must not stat, open, hash, import from, or otherwise touch proxy or label archive paths

receipt.creation: O_WRONLY|O_CREAT|O_EXCL plus O_BINARY when available; canonical pending marker plus LF then fsync
receipt.path_safety: lexical in-repository regular parent with every existing component checked against symlink, junction, and Windows reparse-point escape; no mkdir before receipt
receipt.existing_receipt: empty, partial, pending, invalid, or complete all permanently forbid another run
receipt.post_receipt_failure: catch BaseException and overwrite only the same descriptor with aggregate INVALID_ONE_SHOT_CONSUMED, fsync, close, and never rerun

formal_protocol.context_phase: after receipt, rebuild the visible context once with the frozen official simulator boundary, close/fsync it, and require exact bytes/hash/rows/turns/redaction count before worker launch
formal_protocol.worker_phase: launch two fresh simultaneous isolated workers in the frozen offline environment; each independently constructs one control Agent, consumes the verified identifier-free context in ordinal/turn order, invokes ranking with only the current message and its own causal state, accumulates candidate lines privately, closes Agent and SQLite, then publishes its trace with O_EXCL and emits only an aggregate receipt
formal_protocol.target_blind_boundary: workers cannot access proxy, labels, sample identity, targets, folds, eligibility, or scenario; worker code is statically and synthetically gated against reading future rows into a ranking call, and context/candidate traces are recursively scanned for forbidden keys and catalog identifiers in visible text
formal_protocol.join_phase: only after both workers exit cleanly and both closed traces pass source, schema, exact C100, prefix, uniqueness, and repeat gates may the parent reopen train_explore for target/eligibility and open the numeric fold archive for evaluator-side aggregate membership
formal_protocol.source_close: proxy and label handles are rehashed and fstat-compared on the same open handles before close; all target-free sources are rehashed before final receipt

hard_identity_gates.trace_schema: exactly 20000 ordered records per worker, each containing only global ordinal, turn, and ordered C200
hard_identity_gates.candidate_shape: for every turn 100 <= len(C200) <= 200, every value is a unique non-empty catalog identifier, with no padding
hard_identity_gates.historical_reproduction: each generated C200[:100] must equal the corresponding frozen old C100 byte-for-byte; mismatch, loss, duplicate, or reordering counts are all exactly zero and the normalized C100 digest equals b22b035cb7789570f36db6c52256e5deb67f593f90cbbc5c334d48f2f0a01a67
hard_identity_gates.exact_repeat: the two fresh workers' canonical trace bytes, SHA-256, record count, ordered C200 arrays, derived recall aggregates, and inflation aggregates are exactly equal; timing and RSS are excluded from trace identity
hard_identity_gates.candidate_retention: because old C100 is an exact ordered prefix of both C200 traces, every previous candidate hit is retained and candidate-level hit-to-miss is structurally zero

recall_contract.eligibility: a session is recalled at cutoff K iff its target appears in any C200 prefix K at an eligible turn; intent-override eligibility begins at the frozen override turn
reported_views: C100-absent 14-session frontier as an anonymous aggregate
target-uniform aggregate over exact target clusters
recall_contract.increment: C200 hit and C100 miss; report count/fraction, target-cluster count, outer-fold span, taxonomy span, and first frontier 101..200
recall_contract.forbidden_output: no identifiers, per-session values, targets, ranks, membership vectors, messages, or arrays of length 2000 or 20000

resource_and_inflation_budget.report: per-turn C200 length min/p50/p95/max/mean, added-candidate min/p50/p95/max/mean, candidate-cell ratio, canonical trace-byte ratio, parent peak RSS, each worker lifetime peak RSS, conservative worker sum, P95s, GPU peak, and wall time

decision.structural_or_resource_failure: INVALID_IMPLEMENTATION_CONSUMED; not an algorithm No-Go and no target-derived result may be used
decision.recall_go: all hard gates pass and C200 recall is strictly above C100 with at least one incremental target cluster
decision.recall_no_go: all hard gates pass and C200 recall equals C100
decision.training_evidence_gate: C200 alone may support later training only if target-uniform recall is positive, incremental recall spans at least two frozen outer folds, no old candidate is lost, resources pass, and exact repeat holds
decision.next_stage: record this single fixed C200 result and immediately preregister an independent one-variable C400 LIMIT expansion; do not tune C200 or alter Top10

checkpoint_choreography.formal_gate: HEAD equals the remote implementation commit; worktree clean including untracked nonignored files; exact commit parent and changed-path sets; fixed receipt and cache paths absent; all target-free identities exact
